about.title: About Cyber Security Platform
about.subtitle: We are an educational platform specialized in raising awareness about cybersecurity and data protection.
about.mission_text: In the digital age, protection from cyber threats has become essential. We believe education and awareness are the strongest defense.
about.goal_text: We aim to make cybersecurity accessible and understandable for everyone.
about.vision_text: We aspire to a secure digital society where everyone has the tools to protect themselves.
about.team_desc: Our team consists of cybersecurity experts passionate about delivering high-quality educational content.
about.cta_text: Be part of the cybersecurity community and help spread awareness.
